name: Rajan Anand
bio: Ex-CTO of Razorpay. 12 years in FinTech. Angel-backed 18 startups across payments, lending, and InsurTech. 4 exits including 1 unicorn.
notable_win: Led seed round in Slice (now unicorn), 85x return.
thesis: I back technical founders solving India-specific financial exclusion problems with data moats.

name: Priya Subramaniam
bio: Partner at Accel India. Previously at McKinsey and Sequoia. Focuses on Series A/B in B2B SaaS, HealthTech, and EdTech. Board member at 6 portfolio companies.
notable_win: Lead Series A in Vedantu ($11M), IPO at $600M valuation.
thesis: India's digital infrastructure unlocks 300M new consumers. I back companies that make services accessible at Bharat prices.

name: David Chen
bio: Family office managing $800M. Former Goldman Sachs MD. Focuses on climate-tech, deeptech, and B2B infrastructure across South and Southeast Asia.
notable_win: Early backer of Ather Energy, 40x return at Series D.
thesis: The energy transition is the largest capital opportunity of the century. I back hardware-software convergence in climate.

name: Meera Kapoor
bio: Founder-exit from HealthKart (acquired by Tata). Now angel investing in HealthTech and Consumer Wellness. Harvard MBA. SEBI-registered angel.
notable_win: Seed in 1mg (early), acquired by Tata for $450M.
thesis: Healthcare in India is a preventable tragedy. I fund early diagnostics and mental health startups that reach Tier 2 India.

name: Arjun Mehta
bio: GP at Stellaris. Led investments in 20+ B2B SaaS, FinTech, and AgriTech companies. IIT Delhi + Wharton MBA. Previously at Helion Ventures.
notable_win: Led Mamaearth Seed round; IPO at $1.2B market cap.
thesis: India's 60M SMEs are digitizing in real-time. The best SaaS businesses will be built for Bharat, not copied from the US.

name: Simone Bauer
bio: Head of Siemens Energy Ventures. Industrial cleantech investor. Previously at E.ON Climate Ventures. Focuses on energy transition, industrial AI, and grid technologies.
notable_win: Led GridBeyond Series B; acquired by Schneider Electric for €140M.
thesis: The industrial energy transition needs hardware-software startups that can work inside existing utility and manufacturing infrastructure.

name: Karthik Reddy
bio: Co-founder and Managing Partner at Blume Ventures. 15 years in Indian startup ecosystem. Backed 100+ startups. Board member at Unacademy, Dunzo, and Slice.
notable_win: Pre-seed in Unacademy; valued at $3.4B.
thesis: India-first companies solving problems at massive scale with lean teams and capital efficiency. I back missionaries, not mercenaries.

name: Fatima Al-Rashid
bio: Co-founder exit from Careem (acquired by Uber for $3.1B). Now angel investing in Middle East and South Asia mobility, logistics, and FinTech.
notable_win: Angel in Trella (logistics); Series B at $50M valuation.
thesis: MENA fintech and logistics are 10 years behind India in digitization. I back founders who understand Islamic finance and regional nuance.

name: James Okonkwo
bio: Partner at TLcom Capital, Africa's leading tech VC. Previously at Andreessen Horowitz. Focuses on African B2B SaaS, FinTech, and AgriTech.
notable_win: Series A in Andela; acquired by Andela Holdings at $1.5B valuation.
thesis: Africa has the youngest, fastest-growing population on earth. The infrastructure gap is an entrepreneurial opportunity at continental scale.

name: Neha Jain
bio: YC alumna (W19) with a HealthTech exit. Now YC Scout for India. Helps Indian founders apply to YC and bridges them to Silicon Valley network post-batch.
notable_win: Scouted Juspay into YC; valued at $600M.
thesis: The best Indian B2B SaaS companies should be built for global markets from day one. Founders who think global but build local win.

name: Siddharth Pai
bio: IIT Madras + Harvard Kennedy School. Former McKinsey India Partner. Angel investing in DeepTech, SpaceTech, and Defence tech. ISRO advisor.
notable_win: Early investor in Pixxel (earth observation startup); Series B valuation $200M.
thesis: India's IN-SPACe and iDEX reforms create a decade-long window for deep-tech startups in space and defence. I fund the PhDs who build the hardware.

name: Anika Voss
bio: Investment Manager at Omidyar Network India. Focuses on financial inclusion, digital identity, and skilling. 9 years in impact investing.
notable_win: Led Jai Kisan Series A ($10M); reached 500,000 farmer borrowers.
thesis: Businesses that profit by solving problems for the bottom 300M Indians build the most durable companies and the largest positive impact.

name: Thomas Whitfield
bio: Head of Google for Startups India. Formerly at Andreessen Horowitz and Google Cloud. Focuses on AI-first startups that leverage Google Cloud infrastructure.
notable_win: Early support of Haptik; acquired by Reliance for $100M.
thesis: AI-first companies with defensible data advantages and enterprise distribution. I back founders who can sell to CIOs, not just engineers.

name: Vikram Sunder
bio: Founder-turned-investor. Built and exited 2 SaaS companies. Now runs $30M Fund II at Pravega. Specialist in B2B SaaS for manufacturing and supply chain.
notable_win: Led LogiNext Seed; raised Series B at $120M valuation.
thesis: Manufacturing is India's next GDP growth engine. Founders who understand shop floors and write code in the same breath are the ones I back.

name: Li Wei
bio: Partner at GGV Capital, managing $9.2B AUM across 700+ companies. Focuses on cross-border tech, mobile commerce, and consumer internet across Asia.
notable_win: Early Grab Series A investor; IPO via SPAC at $40B valuation.
thesis: Southeast Asia and India are the fastest-growing consumer internet markets in the world. I fund regional champions with cross-border expansion ambitions.

name: Ananya Krishnan
bio: Ex-VP Product at Flipkart. Startup advisor and angel investor with 9 exits across e-commerce, D2C, and RetailTech. WEF Young Global Leader 2022.
notable_win: Angel in Mensa Brands (D2C roll-up); raised $135M Series B.
thesis: The Indian D2C brand wave is a 10-year opportunity. I back female founders and businesses solving middle-India consumer aspirations.

name: Rohan Malhotra
bio: Co-founder of Good Capital. Previously at Investcorp and PE. Focuses on social impact businesses with market-rate returns across rural India and Bharat.
notable_win: Led Rang De (P2P microfinance); reached 250,000 rural borrowers.
thesis: The 700M Indians outside metro cities are an underserved market, not a charity problem. Profitable businesses built for them create outsized returns.

name: Patricia Osei
bio: Partner at Blossom Capital. Previously at Index Ventures. Focuses on European and South Asian B2B SaaS, Cybersecurity, and LegalTech.
notable_win: Early investor in Darktrace (AI cybersecurity); IPO at £1.7B valuation.
thesis: Cybersecurity is a mandatory spend, recession-proof, and growing 15% CAGR. I fund teams that have spent time inside the threat they're defending against.

name: Rajiv Goel
bio: GP at Matrix Partners India, managing $950M across 4 funds. Board at Ola, Razorpay, and Dailyhunt. 16 years in Indian venture capital.
notable_win: Razorpay Series A; valued at $7.5B.
thesis: Payments and credit infrastructure will be re-built from scratch for India. The winner will touch every SME and consumer in the country.

name: Sunita Bhatia
bio: Serial entrepreneur with 3 exits in chemical manufacturing and cleantech. Now angel investing in climatetech, waste management, and circular economy startups.
notable_win: Early in Chakr Innovation (diesel retrofit); raised Series B at $40M.
thesis: India's pollution and waste crisis is a business opportunity. I fund engineers who've worked inside the problem — not consultants who've read about it.

name: Marco Ferretti
bio: Investment Director at Bosch Ventures. Industrial IoT and automotive tech specialist. Focuses on sensor fusion, robotics, and smart manufacturing globally.
notable_win: Led Bright Machines Series B; manufacturing automation leader at $1B+ valuation.
thesis: Factory automation is inevitable. I fund robotics startups that integrate with legacy equipment rather than replacing it.

name: Divya Menon
bio: Ex-COO of ixigo. Angel investor in travel tech, mobility, and EdTech. Runs Kerala Angels Network, a 140-member angel group focused on Kerala-born founders.
notable_win: Entri App (vernacular EdTech); raised Series B at $30M.
thesis: Kerala has the highest human development index in India but exports its talent. I fund founders who build world-class products from smaller cities.

name: Samuel Eze
bio: Partner at Partech Africa ($140M fund). Previously at IFC and DEG. Focuses on pan-African FinTech, healthcare, and logistics. Board at Wave Mobile Money.
notable_win: Series A Wave Mobile Money; fastest African FinTech to unicorn status ($1.7B).
thesis: Mobile money has unlocked Africa's financial system. The next wave is credit, insurance, and trade finance for informal businesses.

name: Gaurav Sharma
bio: Founder of Veda VC ($15M Fund I). Former ITC FMCG and Unilever. Focuses on FoodTech, D2C brands, and sustainable packaging. SEBI AIF Cat II.
notable_win: Slurrp Farm (healthy kids food); acquired by Marico for ₹66 crore.
thesis: Indian consumer food is shifting from mass market to premium health. I back founders with supply chain depth and brand storytelling.

name: Elena Sorokin
bio: Partner at Tiger Global, managing $35B+ across private and public tech investments. Leads Indian and SEA deal sourcing. Previously at General Atlantic.
notable_win: Flipkart early investor; acquired by Walmart for $16B.
thesis: We invest in market leaders at any stage. Speed, conviction, and zero due diligence drag. We look for 10x revenue growth in 3 years.

name: Mihail Popescu
bio: Founder of UiPath (RPA unicorn, IPO $35B). Now angel investing globally in enterprise automation, AI agents, and developer productivity tools.
notable_win: Founded UiPath; IPO at $35B; largest European tech IPO in history.
thesis: Every knowledge worker will have an AI co-pilot within 5 years. I back the picks and shovels of the AI era, not the applications.

name: Kavitha Nair
bio: Associate at Sequoia Surge (SE Asia and India early-stage accelerator). Focuses on finding pre-seed and seed startups before they're fundable. IIM-A alumna.
notable_win: Kuku FM Seed via Surge; valued at $100M+ Series C.
thesis: Surge backs 20 companies every cohort with $1-2M checks and intensive 16-week programs. I look for founders with obsessive user understanding.

name: Benito Fernandez
bio: Third-generation family office with $500M in assets. Previously backed Rappi (LatAm super-app). Focuses on mobility, logistics, and fintech across LatAm and India.
notable_win: Rappi Series A; reached $5.25B valuation.
thesis: LatAm and India share the same infrastructure gaps, demographic dividend, and smartphone penetration curve. I look for cross-market compounders.

name: Ashwin Raguraman
bio: GP at Bharat Innovation Fund, India's leading deeptech-focused VC. IIT Bombay + MIT. Focuses on defense, semiconductors, space, and quantum computing.
notable_win: Skyroot Aerospace Series B; first private Indian rocket launch.
thesis: India must build its own semiconductor and deep-tech stack. CHIPS Act and PLI schemes create a 15-year tailwind for hardware founders.

name: Yuki Tanaka
bio: Investment Director at Sony Innovation Fund. Focuses on AR/VR, music tech, gaming, and sensor technology globally. Previously at SoftBank Vision Fund.
notable_win: Led Mojo Vision Series B; pioneering AR contact lens technology.
thesis: The creator economy and spatial computing will merge in the next 5 years. I fund the enabling technology — sensors, rendering, and creator tools.
